notes.title: Dice & Sword - Update Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Dear Dice-thrower,

I've been hard at work over the last 2 months fixing the bugs, fixing exploits, and even doing a little bit of gameplay balance tuning. Thank you all for your patience, kindness, and support. Prices have also been adjusted so that more people can join this journey.

Patch 1.1:
Fixed typos and translation errors.
Fixed a bug in the battle value calculation.
Modified the victory conditions of some levels.
Modified the probability of drop rate, especially for name cards.
The Endless Tower has been added, and there is a chance to get hidden characters and items.

notes.title: Demo Update OCT 2024
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the new demo(OCT 2024 ver.) is now officially available. Mainly updated the interface and made the gameplay clearer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819104/4da94a9664f69cf9f15d9ec935292da5ad967bae.png
Added a new instructions for the gameplay, the dialog box is green, if you don't need the instructions, you can skip it directly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819104/76d363b0eb098286b2d1f03b97965d2b7f2439ce.png
Several new elements have been added to the game interface to provide a better gaming experience：
1. Fast forward button, the key function of this update, the game flow will be accelerated after pressing it.
2. Order list, another important feature, you can know clearly the characters that will act next. 
3. Tooltip, simple explanation of the meaning of the icons.
4. Each character's team will be shown.
5. New selector, easier to tell which character is in action.

notes.title: Dice & Sword - Demo Major Update
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the new demo is now officially available. This is the 1 & 2 chapters of the full version of the game, so you can know more about the story of Dice & Sword and the game content. In addition, many bugs have been fixed in this update.

Please note that the old version may affect the operation of the new demo version, if you find any problem, you can try to uninstall it first and then reinstall it. Sorry for any inconvenience.
